warning.title: Content Warning
warning.description: This game explores dark themes including psychological manipulation and moral choices. Player discretion is advised.

actions.cageDesc: Lock the cat in a cage

neighborReport.title: Neighbor's Complaint
neighborReport.description: A neighbor heard strange noises and is asking questions...
neighborReport.choice1: Explain it's just a playful cat
neighborReport.choice2: Tell them to mind their business

catSick.title: The Cat Seems Sick
catSick.description: The cat has been lethargic and refuses to eat...

escapeAttempt.title: Escape Attempt
escapeAttempt.description: You found scratch marks near the window...

attackBehavior.title: Sudden Attack
attackBehavior.description: The cat suddenly scratched your hand...

emotionalConnection.title: Quiet Moment
emotionalConnection.description: The cat approaches you and rests nearby...

injury.title: Accidental Injury
injury.description: The cat got hurt while playing...
injury.choice2: Leave it to heal on its own

partner.title: True Partner
partner.description: Through patience and love, you've formed an unbreakable bond. The cat trusts you completely and follows you everywhere. A beautiful friendship has blossomed from careful nurturing.

numbPuppet.title: Numb Puppet
numbPuppet.description: Fear has consumed all emotion. The cat no longer responds to anything - it simply exists, an empty shell. You have complete control, but at what cost?

escape.title: Escape from Cage
escape.description: One night, the cat seized its chance and disappeared through an open window. You see it sometimes in the neighborhood, wild and free. It never looks back.

revenge.title: Vengeful Spirit
revenge.description: The cat's fear transformed into hatred. One dark night, it attacked with unexpected ferocity. Be careful - wounded souls sometimes bite back.

death.title: Shadow of Death
death.description: Neglect took its toll. The cat grew weaker each day until it could no longer hold on. Some wounds cannot be healed...

ui.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset? All progress will be lost.
